data.summary: Results-driven Scrum Master and Product Owner with 13+ years of IT experience, including 10+ years in Agile delivery. Proven track record of reducing development inefficiencies by 45%, improving project productivity by 30%, and increasing delivery efficiency by 40%. Deep domain expertise across healthcare, pharmacy, banking, insurance, food-tech, and finance. Holds both CSM and CSPO certifications with hands-on experience leading cross-functional teams, managing product roadmaps, and leveraging AI tools to accelerate delivery.

raw_sections.experience:
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
Scrum Master / Product Owner | Genzeon Pvt Ltd | Dec 2024 – Present Domain: US Healthcare Technology | Project: Medrio (Clinical Data Management System)
Led backlog refinement and sprint planning for a clinical EDC/CDMS platform serving pharma, biotech, and medtech clients, ensuring regulatory compliance and quality data capture.
Utilized Microsoft M365 Copilot for user story definition, acceptance criteria authoring, and functional test case generation, reducing story-writing time significantly.
Coordinated with cross-functional teams across the US and India to align sprint deliverables with product roadmap milestones.
Conducted regular UAT sessions and client demos; performed GAP analysis to drive continuous product alignment.
Used Azure DevOps for product backlog management, sprint planning, user-story tracking, task assignment, dependency management, and delivery progress tracking across distributed Agile teams.
Scrum Master / Product Owner | Motivity Labs Pvt Ltd | Jun 2024 – Sep 2024 Domain: Banking / AI-Surveillance | Projects: IVIS & VMS
Managed product backlog and sprint cycles for an AI-enabled e-surveillance system deployed across 2,000+ ATM sites for a major public sector bank.
Facilitated requirements sessions with stakeholders to define features including real-time alerting, AI facial recognition, and cloud-based incident analytics.
Leveraged AI assistants in Rally to accelerate feature creation and dependency tracking across distributed teams.
• Worked with Azure cloud environments including Azure App Services, Azure Functions, Azure Storage, Azure APIs
and Azure DevOps to support cloud-based product delivery and integrations
Scrum Master / Product Owner | Khumbu Information Systems | Jun 2023 – Jun 2024 Domain: Food Tech / Restaurant Integrations | Projects: UberEats Integration & Multi-platform POS
Owned the product backlog for large-scale Uber Eats integrations serving Subway, KFC, Chipotle, Burger King, and 10+ other global restaurant partners across US, Australia, New Zealand, and EMEA.
Defined two-way integration requirements for POS, Loyalty, CRM, Delivery, and In-House restaurant tech stacks; created detailed user stories with clear acceptance criteria.
Produced UML and activity diagrams to visualize system workflows; facilitated stakeholder alignment on complex multi-vendor integrations.
Scrum Master | Altimetrik (Client: Walgreens) | Mar 2018 – May 2023 Domain: Pharmacy / Healthcare | US Omnichannel Pharmacy Platform
Served as Scrum Master for 5+ years on Walgreens' omnichannel pharmacy platform serving ~8 million customers daily, supporting physical and digital prescription, health, and wellness services.
Guided non-agile teams through Agile transformation, resulting in a 40% increase in delivery efficiency. • Established communication channels across teams and stakeholders, improving project productivity by 30%.
Conducted sprint reviews, daily standups, backlog grooming, and retrospectives; managed JIRA board with clearly prioritized epics and stories.
Facilitated CICD adoption across multiple projects and supported defect control and configuration management within the delivery pipeline.
Scrum Master | TCS (Client: Tata AIA Insurance) | Apr 2017 – Feb 2018 Domain: Life Insurance / Financial Services
Facilitated Agile ceremonies for a life insurance platform managing 39M+ individual policies and 16M+ group insurance members across Asia.
Translated business requirements into functional requirements; conducted stakeholder interviews to develop BRDs.
Software Test Engineer | iTrust Soft Solutions | Jan 2013 – Mar 2017
Performed manual and automation testing using Core Java, Selenium, Maven, JUnit, and REST API testing across multiple enterprise projects.
Supported regression testing, defect tracking, and configuration management within the delivery pipeline.
